env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^outer r0$'
stdout '^differential ok$'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/embed

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"
  "reflect"
)

type Base struct {
  B int64 `json:"b"`
}

type Outer struct {
  Base
  R int64 `json:"r"`
}

type Square struct {
  S int64 `json:"s"`
}

type U interface {
  Outer | Square
}

type H struct {
  Item U `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
  var h H
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"r":1}}`), &h); err != nil {
    panic("union unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  o, ok := h.Item.(Outer)
  if !ok || o.R != 0 {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("outer want Outer{R:0} got %T(%v)", h.Item, h.Item))
  }
  fmt.Println("outer r0")
  var direct Outer
  if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"r":1}`), &direct); err != nil {
    panic("direct unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  if !reflect.DeepEqual(o, direct) {
    panic(fmt.Sprintf("differential mismatch union=%v direct=%v", o, direct))
  }
  fmt.Println("differential ok")
}
